4–8 hours (7 missions with travelling all over Tibia)

The secret services of Thais (TBI), Venore (AVIN) and Carlin (CGB) want to uncover all the secrets of Tibia. You choose **one** of the three agencies and carry out seven espionage and sabotage missions around the world. The last mission is the same for everyone: killing the {creature:Mad Technomancer} in Kazordoon. At the end you receive a {item:Mysterious Package} containing a different multi-purpose tool for each agency.
The Secret Services of Carlin, Thais and Venore want to uncover all of Tibia's secrets...
Chester Kahs (TBI, Thais) — or Uncle (AVIN, Venore) / Emma (CGB, Carlin)
Minimum level 50 (60+ recommended). The final mission is hard: bring a team or go at a high level.
You can only complete **one** branch (TBI, AVIN or CGB). Once you start one, you cannot switch.
TBI: {item:Key 5010} (Black Knight Quest) and {item:Key 3012} (to enter Hellgate).
AVIN: {item:Key 5010} and the first mission of {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest} done (to reach the Isle of the Kings).
CGB: {item:Key 5010}. The first mission of {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest} can be done before or during this quest (mission 6).
TBI only, mission 1 (comes from Liberty Bay)
TBI only, to get out of Hellgate (or the Levitate spell)
Money for boat trips (all the missions are in different cities).
TBI only: 1000 gp extra in case you lose the Amazon disguise and have to buy another.
AVIN only: free capacity for an 85 oz beer barrel (mission 3).
when opened, it gives your agency's tool
Achievement **Secret Agent** and **one** of: **Top TBI Agent**, **Top AVIN Agent** or **Top CGB Agent**
Choose the branch by the final tool (see the table in section 1). All three open paths in caves (rope, shovel, pick, machete); the differences are in the extra functions.
In every agency the rhythm is always the same: say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, do the task, come back, say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to hand in, and then {key:mission} again to receive the next one.

The final mission (killing the {creature:Mad Technomancer}) is the hardest. Alternatives: go with a team, go at a high level, or buy the {item:Technomancer Beard} from {npc:Black Bert} (requires {wiki:The Thieves Guild Quest}).
Players who have already finished the quest can enter the final room, so a high-level friend can help you get the beard.
The quest has three branches, one per city: **TBI** in Thais, **AVIN** in Venore and **CGB** in Carlin. They all end with the same final mission and the rewards are similar.
Before you start, decide which tool you want. The table shows what functions each one has.
You can only complete **one** branch. After you say {key:join} and {key:yes} to an agency, you can no longer switch to another.
Follow only the part for your branch: **TBI** (sections 2–8), **AVIN** (sections 9–15) or **CGB** (sections 16–22). Section 23 explains how to open the reward.

The missions take place in several cities. To travel between cities, talk to the boat captain and say {key:hi}, the name of the city (for example {key:venore}) and {key:yes}. To go back to your agency, do the same at the harbour where you are. Captains: {npc:Captain Bluebear} (Thais), {npc:Captain Fearless} (Venore), {npc:Captain Greyhound} (Carlin), {npc:Charles} (Port Hope), {npc:Captain Seahorse} (Edron), {npc:Captain Breezelda} (Svargrond) and {npc:Captain Seagull} (Ab'Dendriel). **Kazordoon** has no boat: go by {wiki:Magic Carpet|flying carpet} (for example from Edron or Svargrond) and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} and {key:yes} to the carpet manager.
Thais branch. Equipment needed for the whole branch: {item:Fire Bug}, {item:Key 5010}, {item:Key 3012}, {item:Crowbar} and money for travel.

Go to {npc:Chester Kahs}, in Thais (1 floor above street level). Say {key:hi}, {key:join}, {key:yes} and then {key:mission}. He sends you to get a {item:Fire Bug} in Liberty Bay and set fire to the Venore shipyard.
Setting fire to the Venore shipyard

With the {item:Fire Bug} in your backpack, travel to **Venore** and go to the shipyard. Go up to the **north-west** corner (1 floor up). Use the Fire Bug on a floor tile next to the wood until it starts to burn. If it does not catch straight away, keep trying.
North-west corner of the Venore shipyard
Using the Fire Bug next to the shipyard wood
When someone sets fire to the shipyard, it burns for **7 minutes**. You can only set fire to it again after the fire goes out.
Go back to {npc:Chester Kahs} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes} to hand in the mission.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Chester Kahs}. An agent disappeared decades ago in the ruins of the Green Claw Swamp, north-west of Venore — and that agent is none other than the {creature:Black Knight}.
Getting to the Black Knight's room

Leave **Venore** through the **north-west** exit and head north-west (towards the {wiki:Amazon Camp (Venore)|Amazon Camp}) to a big ruined building in the swamp: the {wiki:Villa Scapula}. Go down to the basement and go to the **south** end, where there is a door (if it is locked, open it with the {item:Key 5010}, which is in one of the two dead trees **west** of the villa). Go down the stairs, go down again, follow the cave to the end and jump into the hole. Head **south** and climb up with the {item:Rope}. Keep going **south** to the room with the {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and jump into one of the two holes. On the floor of the {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, go **east** to the wall and then **north** to the stairs; go down. To the **north** is the level 50 {item:Gate of Expertise} and, in the big room, step into the teleport to the **north**: it takes you to the {creature:Black Knight}'s room.
Path in the villa — 5 (Gate of Expertise and teleport)
Along the way there are {creature:Bat|Bats}, a {creature:Slime}, {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and a {creature:Wyvern}.
Following the Black Knight Quest route

Follow the route of the {wiki:Black Knight Quest} (you need the {item:Key 5010}). Open the sealed door with a box inside and you receive a {item:Black Knight Forsakes Thais (Book)|parchment}. The two {item:Door (Sealed)|sealed doors} are **south** of the Black Knight's room.
In the Green Claw Swamp and the ruins there are {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and the {creature:Black Knight}, who hits hard.

To leave, step into the teleport on the **south** side of the Black Knight's room: it takes you back to the floor you were on before. From there go back the same way to the basement and the surface (use the {item:Rope} where you went down through holes) and return to Venore through the swamp, to the **south-east**.
Go back to Thais and say to {npc:Chester Kahs}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Chester Kahs}. He wants you to investigate the merchants of Port Hope and look for proof of treason among their belongings.
Entering the house north-east of the depot

Travel to **Port Hope** and go to the depot. To the **north-east** of the depot there is a small house. As soon as you go in, you are attacked by 2 {creature:Pirate Buccaneer|Pirate Buccaneers}. Kill them.
House north-east of the Port Hope depot
Location of the house in Port Hope
Open the chest inside the house and take the {item:Scroll (TBI)|scroll}.
Go back to {npc:Chester Kahs} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Chester Kahs}. An agitator from Carlin was banished by the elves to **Hellgate** with important documents, and you have to recover them.

Go to **Ab'Dendriel** (from Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}'s boat: {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes}). Go down to the floor below (the shops area), go down again next to the little houses and go down once more. Head **south** and then **east** to a door with a sign saying *Hellgate*; open it with the {item:Key 3012} (if you do not have it, the guard {npc:Elathriel}, nearby, sells it to you for 5000 gp). Just to the **north** there is a second door that also needs the {item:Key 3012}. Go through it and step into the portal to {wiki:Hellgate}. Do not use the portal on the **west** side of the room: that one takes you out. In Hellgate you appear on a platform with a ladder: climb it.

The portal is one-way only and there is no protection zone in Hellgate. Before you go in, make sure you have a {item:Rope} and {spell:Levitate} (or 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}): without them you cannot get out.

Enter **Hellgate** with the {item:Key 3012}. The corpse is near the start, past many {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and 2 {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}. On the map, start at point **A** and follow the pink line to the {item:Closed Door (Sealed)|sealed door} at point **B**.
Path in Hellgate: from point A to the sealed door at point B
A vampire boss, {creature:Zevelon Duskbringer}, may appear there.
Open the sealed door, go in and use the corpse inside to receive the {item:Intelligence Reports}.

With the reports, go back the way you came to the first crossing next to the entrance ladder (the Ab'Dendriel portal is one-way only). From there follow the long corridor **west** (only {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}) and go down the hole at the end. Then head **east** along another long corridor (more Skeletons) and go down the next hole. This is the exit route of {wiki:Route:Hellgate|Route:Hellgate}.
Exit route 1: the corridor to the west and the hole at the end
Exit route 2: the corridor to the east and the next hole
Leaving Hellgate 2: going up with the rope and the Rotworm cave

Go **west** and loop round the long corridor (only {creature:Spider|Spiders} and Skeletons) to the yellow circle on the map, where you climb up with the {item:Rope}. Then head **south-east** (a few {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}), go down the hole, walk a little to the **south** (2 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}) and climb up. Follow the path **south** (more Ghouls and Rotworms) and climb up again. Then go **south** and go down the **first** hole you see.
Exit route 3: follow the corridor to the yellow circle and climb up with the rope
Exit route 4 and 5: Rotworm cave and the first hole to the south
Do not stray: other holes on this path have Elves and a {creature:Giant Spider}, and the second rope spot to the south has {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and 1 Ghoul.
Leaving Hellgate 3: the Ghoul room and the 2 floors

Go **west**: you find about 15 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, about 5 {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} (not all at the same time). Cross the big room along the **south** wall and go down the hole. Then head **north-west** (no monsters), go up **2 floors** with {spell:Levitate} or by stacking 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}, and climb the ladder.
Exit route: go up 2 floors with Levitate or Parcels and then the ladder
In the big room there are also {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}, and someone may have pulled them close to your path.
Leaving Hellgate 4: up to the surface

Go **south-west** and climb up through the hole (do not take the hole to the **south-east**: it takes you down, to the lava floor). You may have to pull a lever: it lowers the bridge you have to cross one floor up (it may already be open). From here there are lots of {creature:Wasp|Wasps}, but there is only one way up: follow it until you come out on the surface, near Ab'Dendriel. To get back to Thais, take {npc:Captain Seagull}'s boat in Ab'Dendriel: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}.
Exit route: climb up through the hole to the south-west
Exit route: the bridge lever and the path to the surface
Go back to {npc:Chester Kahs} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.
Asking for the mission and receiving the ring

Say {key:mission} to {npc:Chester Kahs}. He gives you a {item:Suspicious Signet Ring} used by Venore's emissaries. You have to "lose" it in the north-west corner of the top floor of the barbarian leaders' tower, in the southernmost camp.
Travelling to the southern barbarian camp

If you have already done the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest}, travel with {npc:Buddel} in Svargrond: say {key:passage} and {key:camp}. If not, walk across the glacier. First go to **Svargrond** by boat (from Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); {npc:Buddel} is **south** of Svargrond and drops you at the barbarian camp stop. The Ice Witch Tower is further **south**.

Buddel is drunk and may take you to the wrong place. Say {key:passage} again on arrival to check where you are. If you carry a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack, he takes you to the right place (but keeps the ring and you do not pay the 50 gp).
Buddel's stop at the barbarian camp
Using the ring at the top of the Ice Witch Tower

Go up to the **top floor** of the {creature:Ice Witch|Ice Witches} tower (the same tower where {npc:Freezhild} is). Use the {item:Suspicious Signet Ring} on the **north-west corner** of the room. If you do it right, an orange message appears.
Ice Witch Tower (Freezhild's floor); go up to the top
North-west corner at the top of the Ice Witch Tower
The tower and the camp are full of barbarians and {creature:Ice Witch|Ice Witches}.

Go down the tower and back to {npc:Buddel}'s stop at the camp. Say {key:passage} and {key:svargrond} (on arrival, say {key:passage} again to check where you are). In Svargrond, take {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}) to go back to Thais.
Buddel's stop at the barbarian camp
Go back to {npc:Chester Kahs} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.
Asking for the mission and the disguise
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Chester Kahs}. You receive a {item:Disguise Kit (Amazon)|disguise kit} to disguise yourself as an Amazon and break a beer barrel in front of the barbarians of Svargrond.
Going down to the Svargrond tavern cellar
Go to the **Svargrond** tavern and go down to the cellar. Bring your {item:Crowbar}.
Disguising yourself and breaking the barrel

In the cellar, use the disguise and right afterwards use the {item:Crowbar} on the beer barrel in the **north-east corner**. 2 {creature:Barbarian Skullhunter|Barbarian Skullhunters} appear: kill them.
Beer barrel in the north-east corner of the cellar
The disguise wears off after about **20 seconds**. Break the barrel quickly!
If the disguise runs out or you lose it, say {key:disguise} and {key:yes} to Chester Kahs to buy another for 1000 gp.
Go back to {npc:Chester Kahs} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Chester Kahs}. A mad dwarf technician called Blowbeard threatens to destroy Thais. You have to find him in Kazordoon, kill him and bring his beard as proof.
Getting to the Mad Technomancer's room

Go to **Kazordoon**. The {creature:Mad Technomancer} is near {npc:Talphion}. Follow the route in the images to the stairs of his room. The room is full of {creature:Dwarf Henchman|Dwarf Henchmen}, a few {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} and {creature:Mechanical Fighter|Mechanical Fighters}. To get to Kazordoon use a flying carpet (say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes} to the carpet manager, for example in Edron or Svargrond); {npc:Talphion} is at the bottom of the city.
How to get to the Mad Technomancer's room
Map from Kazordoon to the laboratory
Talphion (the Mad Technomancer's room is nearby)

Use **maximum haste** from the stairs, run to the lever in the middle of the room, pull it and go straight back to the stairs before the Dwarf Henchmen surround you. Pulling the lever makes the Mad Technomancer appear together with lots of henchmen.
The {creature:Dwarf Henchman|Dwarf Henchmen} respawn **very** quickly: you cannot kill them all. Do not stay in the middle of the room.
In a team, whoever wants the beard has to go and pull the lever. A high-level knight to block and a high-level mage with UE or GFB are recommended.
Slowly lure the {creature:Mad Technomancer} to the stairs and kill him there. It does not matter who on the team kills him. He **always** drops the {item:Technomancer Beard}.

With the beard, go up the stairs where you fought and go back the same way as in the images to the city. To get back to your agency, take the Kazordoon flying carpet (for example {key:edron}) and then the boat (in Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}).
Go back to {npc:Chester Kahs} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. You receive the title "Top Agent" and a {item:Mysterious Package} with the TBI seal.
If you failed to kill the technomancer, ask Chester Kahs to {key:restart} the mission and try again.
Venore branch. Equipment needed: {item:Key 5010} and the first mission of {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest} done.

Go to {npc:Uncle} in Venore: he is south of the boat, **2 floors up**. Say {key:hi}, {key:join}, {key:yes} and then {key:mission}. You receive a {item:Secret Letter} to deliver to {npc:Gamel} in Thais.
Uncle, south of the Venore boat
Talking to Gamel and killing the bandits
Travel to Thais. When you leave the boat, {npc:Gamel} is in the first house east of the boat, **1 floor down**. Say {key:hi}: he calls 2 {creature:Bandit|Bandits}. Kill them.
After killing the bandits, say {key:hi} again, then {key:letter} and {key:yes}.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Uncle}. He wants you to steal the {item:File AH-X17L89} from Thais castle.
Stealing the file in Thais castle

Go to **Thais** castle. In a room **south** of {npc:King Tibianus}'s throne room there are stairs: go up. On that floor, inside another room, there is a special door. Go in and open the {item:Drawer|drawers} until you find the file.
Asking for the mission and receiving the barrel
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Uncle}. You receive a beer barrel to take to the secret tavern in the Carlin sewers.
The barrel weighs **85 oz**. Make sure you have free capacity.
Going down to the Carlin sewers

Travel to **Carlin** and go down to the sewers, where the secret tavern is. When you go in, 2 {creature:Amazon|Amazons} appear: kill them. {npc:Karl}'s bar is in the {wiki:Carlin Sewers|Carlin sewers}, beneath the city. When you are done, go back to the surface the same way you went down.
Karl, in the secret tavern in the sewers
Talk to {npc:Karl}, behind the counter. Say {key:hi}, {key:barrel} and {key:yes}.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Uncle}. He wants you to kill the black knight hiding in the ruins of the Green Claw Swamp.
Getting to the Black Knight's room

Leave **Venore** through the **north-west** exit and head north-west (towards the {wiki:Amazon Camp (Venore)|Amazon Camp}) to a big ruined building in the swamp: the {wiki:Villa Scapula}. Go down to the basement and go to the **south** end, where there is a door (if it is locked, open it with the {item:Key 5010}, which is in one of the two dead trees **west** of the villa). Go down the stairs, go down again, follow the cave to the end and jump into the hole. Head **south** and climb up with the {item:Rope}. Keep going **south** to the room with the {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and jump into one of the two holes. On the floor of the {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, go **east** to the wall and then **north** to the stairs; go down. To the **north** is the level 50 {item:Gate of Expertise} and, in the big room, step into the teleport to the **north**: it takes you to the {creature:Black Knight}'s room.
Path in the villa — 5 (Gate of Expertise and teleport)
Along the way there are {creature:Bat|Bats}, a {creature:Slime}, {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and a {creature:Wyvern}.
Go to the {wiki:Black Knight's Villa} (you may need the {item:Key 5010}) and kill the {creature:Black Knight}.
If you go as a team, **each member** has to kill the Black Knight once (by being the one who deals him the most damage).

To leave, step into the teleport on the **south** side of the Black Knight's room: it takes you back to the floor you were on before. From there go back the same way to the basement and the surface (use the {item:Rope} where you went down through holes) and return to Venore through the swamp, to the **south-east**.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Uncle}. You have to fetch a ring from the depths of the tombs of the **Isle of the Kings**.
Get to the Isle of the Kings

Go to **Carlin** (from Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}'s boat: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}) and then to {npc:Dalbrect}'s hut and boat, at the harbour to the **north and west** of the city (north of the {wiki:Ghostlands}). Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}: he takes you to the {wiki:Isle of the Kings} for 10 gp. He only accepts if you have already done the first mission of {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest} (the Family Brooch).
Dalbrect (boat to the Isle of the Kings)
First visit to the Isle of the Kings
If it is your first time on the Isle of the Kings, talk to {npc:Costello} and say {key:Brother Fugio}.
Go down through the catacombs until you reach the first "real" cave. Kill everything there and go as far **south-west** as possible.
You find a door with a flashing handle. Go in and pick up the ring as shown in the image.
Leave the Isle of the Kings

Go back up through the catacombs to the monastery, the same way. To return to the mainland, go to the boat moored at the island and talk to {npc:Captain Jack}, Dalbrect's friend: say {key:hi} and {key:tibia}. He takes you back to the mainland, to the Carlin side.
Do not enter the 3rd floor of the monastery (the monks' restricted area): if you do, Captain Jack will not take you back until you pay the fine to {npc:Costello} ({key:absolution}).
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Uncle}. You receive a box of weapons to bribe the barbarians. Most of them attack you on sight, so you have to find someone willing to talk to you.

Go to **Svargrond** by boat (from Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). If you have already done the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest}, talk to {npc:Buddel}, **south** of Svargrond, and say {key:passage} and {key:camp}; if not, walk across the glacier. Buddel is drunk and may take you to the wrong place: on arrival, say {key:passage} again to check where you are. The Ice Witch Tower is **south** of Buddel's stop at the camp.
Buddel's stop at the barbarian camp
If you carry a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack, Buddel takes you to the right place (but keeps the ring and you do not pay the 50 gp).
Go to the big barbarian camp and enter the **Ice Witch Tower**. {npc:Freezhild} is on the **second floor** of the tower. Say {key:hi}, {key:weapons} and {key:yes}.
Freezhild, in the Ice Witch Tower
On the way there are aggressive barbarians and {creature:Ice Witch|Ice Witches}.

Go down the tower and back to {npc:Buddel}'s stop at the camp. Say {key:passage} and {key:svargrond} (on arrival, say {key:passage} again to check where you are). In Svargrond, take {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) to go back to Venore.
Buddel's stop at the barbarian camp
Go back to Venore and say to {npc:Uncle}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Uncle}. A criminal dwarf called Blowbeard is blackmailing Venore. His laboratory is near the technomancer hall, in Kazordoon. Bring his beard as proof.

It is the same final mission as the TBI: follow the steps in **section 8** (get to the room near {npc:Talphion}, pull the lever, run to the stairs and kill the {creature:Mad Technomancer}). He always drops the {item:Technomancer Beard}. At the end, go up the stairs and go back the same way to the city; then return to your agency by flying carpet and boat (see section 8).
How to get to the Mad Technomancer's room
Map from Kazordoon to the laboratory
It is the hardest mission: the {creature:Dwarf Henchman|Dwarf Henchmen} respawn non-stop. A high-level knight to block and a high-level mage using UE or GFB are recommended.
Go back to {npc:Uncle} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Mysterious Package}.
When you use the package you receive the Sneaky Stabber of Eliteness
Carlin branch. Equipment needed: {item:Key 5010}. The first mission of {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest} can be done during mission 6.

Go to {npc:Emma} in Carlin: she is above the prison where {npc:Shauna} is, in the east of the city. Say {key:hi}, {key:join}, {key:yes} and then {key:mission}. (If you are a man she makes fun of you, but accepts you anyway.)
Stealing the book in the Ivory Towers
Travel to **Edron** and go to the library of the **Ivory Towers** (the academy). Behind a quest door is the {item:Nature Magic Spellbook}: pick it up.
Quest door in the Ivory Towers library
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Emma}. You have to rip out the heart of the master tree of the death trees in the Green Claw Swamp, north-west of Venore.
Getting to the Black Knight's room

Go down to the basement and go to the **south** end, where there is a door (if it is locked, open it with the {item:Key 5010}, which is in one of the two dead trees **west** of the villa). Go down the stairs, go down again, follow the cave to the end and jump into the hole. Head **south** and climb up with the {item:Rope}. Path in the villa — 5 (Gate of Expertise and teleport)
Along the way there are {creature:Bat|Bats}, a {creature:Slime}, {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and a {creature:Wyvern}.
Go to the {wiki:Black Knight Villa} and get to the {wiki:Black Knight Quest} room (with the {item:Key 5010}). Kill the {creature:Black Knight}.
Near the teleport there is a tree behind a sealed door. Use the tree and you receive the {item:Rotten Heart of a Tree}.
Tree behind the sealed door, near the teleport

To leave, step into the teleport on the **south** side of the Black Knight's room: it takes you back to the floor you were on before. From there go back the same way to the basement and the surface (use the {item:Rope} where you went down through holes) and return to Venore through the swamp, to the **south-east**.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Emma}. She gives you a {item:Case of Rust Bugs} to sabotage the Ironhouse forge in Venore.
Using the rust bugs on the lock
Go to **Venore**, to the Ironhouse basement. Use the {item:Case of Rust Bugs} on the marked door (lock). A {item:Bug Trail} appears on the other side.
Door where to use the rust bugs
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Emma}. She wants the plans for a new Venore ship.
Go to the **Venore** shipyard, in the north-west of the city (1 floor up), and pick up the {item:Building Plans for a Ship}.
Ship plans at the Venore shipyard
Location of the plans at the shipyard
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Emma}. You have to investigate the ruins of the **Dark Cathedral**, south-west of Venore.

Go to **Venore** (from Carlin, take the boat of {npc:Captain Greyhound}: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}). Leave the city heading **southwest**: the {wiki:Dark Cathedral} lies south of the Venore swamp and the Outlaw Camp, **west** of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, and you can only get there by crossing the plains. The first two floors go down by stairs; the deepest floor can only be reached through the teleport.
In the middle of the plains there may be {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} that someone has lured onto the path.

Enter the {wiki:Dark Cathedral}. You have to pull all the levers to activate the teleport that leads to the deepest level (the same floor as {npc:Angelina}). It is much easier with a few friends. From the stairs on the second floor, head **south** to a big room: the teleport is at the end of it and the 6 levers are in the 5 rooms around it. There is a time limit after you pull the levers, so step into the teleport straight away.

You will face all the monsters of the Dark Cathedral: {creature:Witch|Witches}, {creature:Dark Magician|Dark Magicians}, {creature:Dark Apprentice|Dark Apprentices}, {creature:Dark Monk|Dark Monks}, {creature:Assassin|Assassins}, {creature:Bandit|Bandits}, {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and, sometimes, {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} lured along the way.
Open the box in the northwest room
On the deepest level, go to the **northwest** room. Open the quest box and take the {item:Suspicious Documents}.

To leave, use the teleport that takes you out of the deepest floor, next to {npc:Angelina}, then climb the stairs you came down back up to the surface. Return to Venore the same way and take the boat to Carlin ({npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}).
Angelina, next to the exit teleport
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Emma}. She wants a book with stories of old families, kept in a tomb in the crypts of the Isle of the Kings.
Get to the Isle of the Kings (if you do not have access yet)

Here you can start the {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest}: get the {item:Family Brooch} and hand it over to {npc:Dalbrect}. Tell him in this order: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:project}, {key:name}, {key:carlin}, {key:ship}, {key:passage}, {key:brooch}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}. Then ask for {key:passage} again to travel. {npc:Dalbrect} is in the hut next to his boat, in the harbour **north and west** of Carlin. If you already have access, just say {key:hi}, {key:passage} and {key:yes} (10 gp).
Dalbrect (boat to the Isle of the Kings)
If it is your first time on the Isle of the Kings, talk to {npc:Costello} and say {key:Brother Fugio}. That way you can go through the door on the left to head down.
Pick up the book in the crypt

At the White Raven Monastery you do not need to go into the caves: the {item:Book (CGB)|book} is in a crypt, **4 floors below the surface**. You will only find {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and one {creature:Demon Skeleton}.
Book in the crypt of the Isle of the Kings
Location of the book in the crypt
It is easier with {spell:Invisible}: only the Ghouls can see you.
Leave the Isle of the Kings

Climb the 4 floors of the crypt back the same way to the monastery. To return to the mainland, go to the boat docked on the island and talk to {npc:Captain Jack}, a friend of Dalbrect: say {key:hi} and {key:tibia}. He takes you back to the mainland, to the Carlin side.
Do not enter the 3rd floor of the monastery (the monks' restricted area): if you do, Captain Jack will not take you back until you pay the fine to {npc:Costello} ({key:absolution}).
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Emma}. A mad dwarf threatens to destroy Carlin. His laboratory is in Kazordoon, near the technomancer hall. Bring back his beard as proof.

It is exactly the same final mission as the TBI and the AVIN: follow the steps of **section 8** (room near {npc:Talphion}, pull the lever, run to the stairs, kill the {creature:Mad Technomancer}). He always drops the {item:Technomancer Beard}. At the end, go up the stairs and return the same way back to the city; then head back to your flying carpet and boat agency (see section 8).
How to get to the Mad Technomancer's room
Map from Kazordoon to the laboratory
The {creature:Dwarf Henchman|Dwarf Henchmen} respawn very quickly. Use haste and do not stay in the middle of the room.
Go back to {npc:Emma} and say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Mysterious Package} with the CGB seal.

Use the {item:Mysterious Package} (it weighs 10 oz and carries the seal of your agency). You receive the tool of your branch: {item:Whacking Driller of Fate} (TBI), {item:Sneaky Stabber of Eliteness} (AVIN) or {item:Squeezing Gear of Girlpower} (CGB).
Agency tool + Secret Agent and Top TBI/AVIN/CGB Agent achievements
Before Update 8.50 the {item:Mysterious Package} could not be used; since then it gives one of the {wiki:Secret Agent Tools} depending on the agency.
In the final mission, whoever wants the beard has to pull the lever personally, even in a team.
If you fail the Mad Technomancer mission on the TBI branch, you can ask Chester Kahs to {key:restart} that mission.
